title: Travel booking
description: Hotel shortlist plus a booking form with date pickers, guest count and room type.
prompt: I want to book a 4-night trip to Lisbon in late March for 2 adults. Show me 3 hotel options with nightly price, rating and neighborhood, and give me a booking form with check-in and check-out date pickers, a guest count selector and room type.

title: Product comparison
description: Spec-by-spec comparison table with a recommendation.
prompt: Compare three popular noise-cancelling headphones side by side: Sony WH-1000XM5, Bose QuietComfort Ultra and Apple AirPods Max. Include list price, battery life, weight, noise cancelling, codecs and multipoint, then recommend one for frequent flyers.

title: Analytics dashboard
description: KPI cards, an MRR trend line, stacked signups and a plan-mix donut.
prompt: Give me a dashboard for my SaaS for the last 6 months: MRR, active users, churn and conversion as headline metrics, an MRR trend chart, signups by channel, and plan mix.

title: Appointment form
description: A complete booking form: selects, date picker, time chips and radio groups.
prompt: I need to book a dental cleaning. Make me an appointment request form: choose a clinic location, preferred date, time slot, dentist preference, whether I'm a new patient, insurance provider and any notes.

title: Support ticket triage
description: Prioritised ticket table with tags, owners and first-response steps.
prompt: Triage these incoming support tickets for me: 1) 'Checkout fails with error 502 since this morning' from Acme Corp (enterprise), 2) 'How do I export my invoices?' from a free user, 3) 'SSO login loops back to the sign-in page' from Globex (business), 4) 'Feature request: dark mode in the mobile app', 5) 'I was charged twice this month' from a pro user. Show priority, category, suggested owner and next steps.

title: Recipe card
description: Times, a scalable ingredient table, steps and nutrition facts.
prompt: Give me a recipe card for a weeknight Thai green curry for 4: prep and cook time, difficulty, ingredients list, step-by-step instructions, nutrition per serving, and a quick option to scale servings.
